summary: Ubooquity is a self-hosted server designed to organise and stream digital comic and e-book collections across multiple platforms. It provides a centralised web interface so you can access your reading materials from various devices on your home network.
goodFor: This is suitable if you want a dedicated, lightweight application specifically tailored to serving comic books and e-books rather than general-purpose document storage.
watchOut: The software is proprietary and unmaintained, which means you will not receive security patches or bug fixes, and you have no access to the source code if issues arise.
deployNotes: Because it is built with Java, you will typically need to provision a Java Runtime Environment on your host system and ensure persistent storage is attached for your library files.
